nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Set your Slack credential + pick the channel (e.g. #logistics-alerts). To send by email instead, swap this node for a Gmail node using {{ $json.message }} as the body.

nodes.name: Get StockMovements
nodes.notes: Read the StockMovements ledger. After import: pick the StockMovements doc + tab from the dropdowns.

nodes.name: Get PurchaseOrders (open)
nodes.notes: Read PurchaseOrders to suppress SKUs already on order. Select the PurchaseOrders doc + tab.

nodes.name: Log Reorder POs
nodes.notes: Append PENDING reorder POs (source=reorder). Same PurchaseOrders sheet.
